title: dLocal Limited Unaudited Consolidated Condensed Interim Financial Statements at June 30, 2026
excerpt: Weighted average number of common shares for calculating diluted earnings per share
summary: The Q2 interim statements report six-month net income attributable to common shareholders of USD 96.6 million, Q2 diluted EPS of USD 0.18, Q2 diluted weighted-average shares of 295.9 million, USD 369.1 million corporate cash, and 6.9 million repurchased and cancelled Class A shares. The top ten merchants remained 61% of revenue and two merchants individually exceeded 10% of six-month revenue. The statements distinguish merchant cash from corporate liquidity and detail the repurchase, dividend, employee-plan dilution, working-capital and payment-settlement balances used in valuation normalization.
